title: Changelogs
text: Changelogs Skip to content × Search for: Convergence Mod Version 2.2.3 - Latest Additions and Changes Maps Improved the Detailing of the Church before Malenia in Miquella’s Haligtree. Improved the Enemy Density and Palette, also Extended the Progression of Volcano Cave. Improved the Enemy Density and Parkour Section of Gelmir’s Hero Grave. Improved the Lighting in Academy Crystal Cave. Improved the Detailing, Progression and Enemy Palette of Limgrave Tunnel. Improved the Lighting and Enemy Palette of Impalers Catacombs. Improved the Lighting and Enemy Density of Roads End Catacombs. Improved the Lighting of Earthbore Cave. Improved the Enemy Density and Extended the Progression of Morne Tunnel. The teleporters at the end of Minor Dungeons will now use a fade out teleport instead of a loading screen. This in turn will also make it so that the enemies will not respawn after using these teleporters. Menu Named the Owl in the Santuary of Lost Knowledge, Selwyn the Owl. Weapons The Aegis of Hadea can now equip other Shield Ashes of War, overwriting it’s ability to Cast Incantations. Enemies Improved the reliability of the Chain attack of Konrad, Pureblood Knight Bug Fixes Maps Fixed an issue where there were a couple invisible walls in Deeproot Depths. Fixed an issue where there was a sheep stuck in the floor near the Inner Wall of Castle Morne Fixed several enemy pathing issues in Miquella’s Haligtree Fixed several visual errors in Miquella’s Haligtree\ Menu Fixed an issue where Selwyn the Owl did not mention the Vessel of Rot for the Third Keystone of the Forge. Corrected the location of the Radiant Rune of Bloodflame on the Path of the Blood Initiate Class Note Enemies Fixed an issue where a Godrick Knight in Castle Morne would get cold feet to help out in a big battle. Fixed an issue where many NPCs were unable to cast spells. Weapons Fixed an issue where pressing L2 at just the right moment while having the Aegis of Hadea two handed would cause you to perform a Fire Breath animation. Special Thanks to Snuppet for helping with this bug, as it required frame-perfect input and was hard to recreate. Talismans Fixed an issue where the Verdigris Talisman did not provide immunity to Grab Attacks. Version 2.2.2 Bug Fixes Fixed an issue causing a console window to appear upon launch. Fixed an issue causing the Blades of the Prince and the Guardian Spearblade to not function correctly. Version 2.2.1 Additions and Changes General Improved the stability of the Start_Convergence.bat, allowing a better out of the box experience. Music Updated Shabriri’s Chosen theme (rework) Updated Goras, Scourge of Dreams theme (remaster) Menu Updated Tutorial and Loading Screen Descriptions with more details: Weapon Duplication Enemies Nerfed Death Knight Lenny in Deeproot Depths to have a lower reinforced catalyst and weapon. Bug Fixes Maps Fixed issues with the generated navmesh wall assets in Redmane Castle and Deeproot Depths to block off some progression. Fixed an issue where the boss walls didn’t disappear upon killing Ulcerated Tree Spirit in Deeproot Depths. Fixed an issue on the Mohgwyn Palace map that caused an infinite fall bug on reaching certain spots. Menu Removed an unintended message that would occur when interacting with the Forge of the Giants portal while not having any Keystones of the Forge. Fixed several grammatical errors and typos. Enemies Fixed a rare issue where spellcasting albino Beastmen of Farum Azula would use curved sword attacks while not wielding a weapon. Fixed an issue where the boss Soundtrack for the Death Knight boss in Deeproot Depths didn’t trigger. Fixed an issue where the boss Soundtrack for the Siluria boss in Deeproot Depths didn’t trigger. Fixed an issue with the boss health bars in Deeproot Depths would pop up for a short time even after defeat. Fixed an issue with Aberrant Heretic Loreena not properly using her weapon. Fixed an issue where Moongrum was using the wrong skill on his weapon. Weapons Fixed an issue where holding a Heavy Milady would cause the following things to break: Magic Weapon Detection for Armor Abilities Action Speed-up buffs Quiver Talisman Tricia’s Pomander State Swapping Rancor Touch Visuals Greater Rebirth Web Page Opener (Sanctuary of Lost Knowledge) Disabling Spells on Stat Loss Disabling Spells on Melee Ability 0 FP cost to disable Toggle Spells Rune Level 1 Detection Spirit Summon Related Spells Forced Disable Ray Tracing Online Session Detection No Greatrune Equipped Detection Fixed an issue where the Blades of the Prince would not have a description. Fixed an issue where the Zephyr Blades would instead be called the Sharktooth Curved Sword. Fixed an issue causing the Blades of the Prince to do a second Heavy Attack after landing when doing a Jumping Heavy Attack. Fixed an issue where using the Bracelets of Shadow in your Left Hand and using it’s Weapon Skill while two-handing would cause the Bracelets of Shadow Weapon Skill to partially play instead. Spells Fixed an issue where some spells would be cast twice when being cast twice on horseback. Version 2.2 Additions and Changes General Added several music tracks to the Convergence Bosses. See more in the Music section of the Patch Notes. Removed the ability to ride a Mount while in an active Erdtree Portal fight when you are walled in. New Feature: Greater Rebirth - at Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon Get your Runes back that you have put into leveling up your Attributes, which you can then use on other things or for example refight a boss at a lower level. In addition to a Larval Tear, Greater Rebirth will cost Runes equal to your last level up. These Runes will be deducted from the amount of Runes refunded. Transmogrify Armor by Tom Clark has been updated: 2.3.8 ► 2.4.2 Armor and Weapon Dyes by Tom Clark has been updated: 1.0.2 ► 1.1.4 Script Data Exposer by ElaDiDu has been updated: 1.0.8 ► 1.0.9 CMI (Custom Music Injector) by Pear has been added: 1.0.0.0 Maps Overhauled Legacy Dungeon: Mohgwyn Palace. Overhauled Legacy Dungeon: Miquella’s Haligtree. Overhauled Legacy Dungeon: Crumbling Farum Azula. Improved the new player experience. (Details will be updated later) Remastered the Forge of the Giants Portal to be more interactive. Expanded Gideon, the All-Knowing’s book collection. Added a new Waygate between Demi-Human Isle and Shack of the Lofty. Added a Stake of Marika to Siluria’s arena in Deeproot Depths. Added a semi-invisible variant of the Mounts in the Stables in Roundtable Hold, to give a hint as to what Mounts are not collected yet. The Minor Erdtrees at the Erdtree Nursery will now instantly show up when giving enough Golden Seeds Added a new Site of Grace in Volcano Manor, Temple Canyon. Replaced the Erdtree Door in Castle Morne with a Two Fingers Magical Seal to better communicate to the player that there’s something behind it. Tweaked the Crystal Jump in Raya Lucaria to make it easier. Tweaked a teleport skip in Caria Manor. Removed the Stake of Marika from Astel’s Cave now that there’s a Site of Grace. Added a screen title to the following places Weeping Peninsula Harbor > Weeping Harborage Caelid Harbor > Dragonbarrow Port Astel’s Cave > Naturalborn’s Rest Added Pseudo-Navmesh (which enemies use to navigate terrain) to the following areas: Castle Morne Castle Morne Town Deeproot Depths Redmane Castle Stormveil Castle Stormveil Rampart Raya Lucaria Caria Manor Sellia, Town of Sorcery Dreaming Spirit Grounds Nokron Guardian’s Garrison Stormhill Minor Erdtree Music New Menu Track: Main Menu (Convergence) New Boss Track: Spiritshaper Caimar New Boss Track: Godskin Matriarch New Boss Track: Einar, Ice Guardian New Boss Track: Dyru, Scavenger King New Boss Track: Goras, Scourge of Dreams New Boss Track: Shabriri’s Chosen New Boss Track: Skarde, Crucible Betrayer New Boss Track: Scion of the Sealed God New Boss Track: Seera, Blade of the Ancients New Boss Track: Dakk, Starcaller Lord New Boss Track: Rhys, Carian Paragon New Boss Track: Sigur, Night’s Captain New Boss Track: Blighted Nox Ancestor New Boss Track: Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree New Boss Track: Leonine Misbegotten New Ambient Track: Sanctuary of Lost Knowledge Menu Edited and removed several vanilla Loading Screen tooltips to remove information no longer relevant in Convergence. All Loading Screen tooltips have been given the prefix “Convergence”, “Vanilla”, or “Vanilla*” to denote tooltips that are new, from the base game, or from the base game and have been slightly edited respectively. Updated all the game’s text to include several Vanilla updates and corrections. Added new Loading Screen tooltips regarding Convergence features and mechanics: Erdtree Waygates Status: Immunity Talismans Spell Catalyst Affinities Spell Catalysts Scaling Linear Scaling Golden Extract Removed Random Drops Sacred Ward Weapon Duplication Spirit Ash Resummoning Spirit Ash Summoning Sickness FP Regeneration Current Rend and Concussion Immolation Soul Burn and Soul Annihilation Frostbite Shatter Quicksilver Consume All Runes Fast Travel Changes Glass Shards Holy Ammunition Persistent Night Lucarian Nexus Pacifist Bell Bearings Recipe Changes Defeating Powerful Enemies Unique Powerstance Options Four Belfries and Imbued Sword Keys Shattering Miquella's Great Rune Crumbling Farum Azula Moonlight Altar Class Weapons Without Affinities Enemies New Boss - Konrad, Pureblood Knight, found in Mohgwyn Palace. New Boss - Bloodflame Dragon Sanguivaros, found in Mohgwyn Palace. New Boss - The Rotten Monk, replaces the Kindred of Rot at the South Caelid Erdtree Portal. New Boss - Charred Banished Knight, replaces the Colossal Finger Creeper at East Mt. Gelmir Erdtree portal. Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon has been adjusted: The Juvenile Scholars in the first phase will now only spawn in the inner parts of the arena. Most of her second phase summons have been removed. She will now teleport away and spawn 2 clones that perform a single attack before disappearing instead of performing her summons in phase 2. The only remaining summon is Blaidd. (A previously unused summon by Fromsoft) She will only perform this summon when below 50% HP in phase 2. Restored an unused sweeping lateral Comet Azur attack in phase 2. Added a Triple Glintbeam Orb attack in phase 2. Increased her HP in phase 2. Accelerated the animations of several of her attacks in phase 2. Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy has been adjusted: His phase 1 spin attack that happens at close range has been accelerated. He is more likely to perform his single and double rancor attacks in phase 2. His “Rancor Inferno” attack animation has been accelerated, making it more difficult to interrupt in phase 2. The phase 2.5 attacks will be possible starting 65% health instead of 50% Adjusted the hitboxes on several of his phase 2 attacks to make them more likely to hit the player while at melee range. Accelerated the animations of his jumping attacks in phase 2 and made them more likely to happen while at melee range. Increased his poise in phase 2 by 15%. Lichdragon Fortissax has been adjusted: His AoE lightning curse now affects a much larger radius but deals less damage and no longer causes the player to stagger when hit by it. Accelerated many of his animations including his fire breath and lightning stake attacks. Starscourge Radahn has been adjusted: The player and the boss now begin the fight much closer together after the portal into the arena. His poise-break animation has been extended to allow for more consistent ripostes. Increased his poise by 12%. He is now capable of pulling out his bow more often while at moderate to far range. He will utilize his “levitating corkscrew” attack more often in phase 2. Mohg, Lord of Blood has been adjusted: He will now teleport to the player at the beginning of the fight rather than walk slowly down the stairs. He is now capable of occasionally teleporting away from the player while close or teleporting toward the player while far. These teleports can happen more frequently in phase 2. Fire Giant has been adjusted: The camera has been zoomed out during the fight. His more damage-resistant body locations have been adjusted to receive considerably greater damage. Slightly increased his overall HP. The range of his flame breath in phase 2 has been significantly decreased, this will lower the chance that the player will be hit by the flames rebounding off of the terrain. Shabriri’s Chosen has been adjusted: The Frenzied Rain in the second phase will do a two second buildup to a large explosion when touching the ground. The Frenzied Rain in the second phase will now only have big explosions. The Frenzied Rain Explosions will now no longer stagger the player. Reduced his run speed by 15%. Slightly slowed down his one-handed double slash start-up animation. Lowered the stagger level of his one-handed double slash so it is no longer a true combo. Adjusted the turn angle and speed of his running slash to make it less likely to slightly run past the player. Slowed down the cast animation of his long range flare spell by 15%. Added additional recovery time to many of his attacks that don’t chain into other attacks and to the end animations of his combo attacks. Slightly slowed down his phase transition animation. Midra, Lord of the Frenzied Flame has been adjusted: You will no longer be required to do the 1 phase of Midra where he is impaled if you have done so in a previous attempt. In these cases Midra will start as the Frenzied Lord version. As per community vote he will continue to shout ‘The Depths of your Foolishness’ when entering the bossroom, disregarding the lack of a head. When refought after defeating Impaled Midra on a previous attempt, he will no longer perform a scripted attack where he walks towards the player and shoots a wide ranged frenzy salvo for several seconds. New Hostile NPC: Aberrant Heretic Loreena - Found in Shaded Castle. New Hostile NPC: Dragon Mage Caleb - Found in Ordina, Liturgical Town. New Hostile NPC: Death Knight Lenny - Found in Deeproot Depths. New Hostile NPC: Starcaller Dumpy - Found in Yelough Anix Tunnel. New Hostile NPC: Blood Initiate Parky - Found in Moghwyn Palace. New Hostile NPC: Godskin Celebrant Prod - Found in the Divine Tower of Caelid. New Hostile NPC: Bee the Relentless - Found near Woodfolk Ruins. New Hostile NPC: Squilla of the Golden Order - Found in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. Replaced the Dragonkin Soldier in Deeproot Depths with Aled, Knight of Godwyn. Adula’s 3rd encounter in Caria Manor, in front of the boss room to Einar, Ice Guardian is now no longer a one-time event but is on a cooldown. Skarde’s shield has gotten a new visual effect. Skarde’s shield now absorbs spells instead of deflecting them around him. Einar, Ice Guardian has had his damage lowered by 15% Dyru, Scavenger King has had his damage lowered by 15% Scion of the Sealed God has had her damage lowered by 15% Removed the ability for various Erdtree Portal Bosses to be affected by Charms. The Blighted Omen can now hit the Blighted Commoners around him. The Erdtree Sentries in Leyndell, Royal Capital will no longer respawn after being killed. Added the ability to attack players behind him to Dyru, Scavenger King. Added the ability to attack players behind him to Rhys, Carian Paragon. Added 4 new lock-on points at the knees to the Regal Ancestor Spirit. Armor New Armor Set: Caimar’s Set (Mystic | Hybrid) - Bought from Enia’s shop. New Armor Set: Carian Golem Set (Glint | Melee) - Looted from the Carian Golem in Caelid. Added Renalla’s Crown (modified version) to Enia’s shop. Made Renalla’s Crown (original version) into an Armor Alteration. Moved the Ascetic's Wrist Guard to the Weeping Harborage. The Caustic Coating ability from the Leather Set now has a 30 second duration, instead of it being tied to the duration of a Weapon Grease. Mounts The Erdtree Steed’s Trample Ability will now scale with effects that boost Horseback Attacks. Increased the base damage of the Erdtree Steed’s Trample Ability from 125 to 385. Added various Talisman bonuses to be shared with your mount while equipped: Lance Talisman Ritual Sword Talisman All Ritual Talismans (5%, 7.5%, 10% and 12.5% damage talismans) Added various Physick Tears to be shared with your mount while active: Stonehoof Cracked Tear Crimsonburst Crystal Tear Crimson Crystal Tear Crimsonspill Crystal Tear Opaline Hardtear Opaline Bubbletear Speckled Hardtear Leaden Hardtear All Shrouding Cracked Tears (10% damage increase of a damage type) Purifying Crystal Tear (no effect on Torrent) Added various Miscellaneous buffs to be shared with your mount while active: Bloodboil Aromatic Rallying Standard Golden Vow (Ash of War) Golden Vow (Item) Items New Consumable: Sacred Ward - Obtained by offering Sacred Tears at the Erdtree Nursery, Northeast of the Minor Erdtree Church in Altus. Gives the user the ability to Defy Death once. Until triggered this will persist through loading screens. Included the statistics of several Talismans in their Description. Updated the Skeletal Mask description to contain the duration of the disengage effect provided by the armor ability. Updated the Note: Weapons for Marksman to have unique entries from the Vanguard and Retainer class weapon notes. Added a method of obtaining Thiollier’s set and Thiollier’s Hidden Needle from Thiollier after completing an earlier quest step. You can now receive the items through a dialogue option available after delivering the black syrup from Moore. Updated the Description for the spell Sacred Ground to reflect the new effects provided to allies while in the area. Updated the Item Icons for the 5 Keystones of the Forge. Replaced a pickup Relic Remnant in Mohgwyn Palace with a Great Somber Stone Weapons Remade the Trick Weapon system using a different method: Trick Weapons now change shape by tapping the Ash of War. Trick Weapons can now use both the One-Handed and Two-Handed moveset of both forms. Trick Weapons will have a transformative attack that occurs when you Tap L2 right after an attack. The Guardian Swordspear has received a remastered Ash of War (Hold L2). New Weapon: Blades of the Prince. (Dragon Cult Twin Daggers | Throwing Weapons) - Found in Altus Plateau chest east of Stormcaller Church . New Weapon: Bracelets of Gold (Strength Hand to Hand) - Obtained after defeating the Ulcerated Tree Spirit at Leyndell's Outer Wall. New Weapon: Bracelets of Shadow (Dexterity Hand to Hand) - Found in Mirage Rise. New Shield/Seal Hybrid: Aegis of Hadea - Found in Hidden Path to the Haligtree. Gilded Quarterstaff has had its Ash of War updated with new inputs. The Spirit Glaive Ash of War (Rancor slash) has been reworked. The Scepter of the All-Knowing can now be used as a Weapon Catalyst for both Sorceries and Incantations, but only if the player character is Rune Level 1. The Staff of the Great Beyond has received proper spell scaling balance. Restored the original moveset of Morgott's Cursed Sword. Restored the original Charged Heavy Attack of the Iron Cleaver. Reduced the Skill damage of the Repeating Crossbow Ash of War by 25%. Reduced the Hitbox Size and Hitbox Duration of the Golden Arrow’s Buff. Weapon Greases and Weapon Spell Buffs will now not be removed by swapping Trick Weapon forms or performing certain Weapon Skills. Whirling Black Flames (Godskin Peeler) Black Flame Tornado (Ash of War) Cursed-Blood Slice (Morgot’s Cursed Blade Rancor Slash (Spirit Sword) The following weapons can change their skills now (not affinities): Daggers: Celebrant's Sickle Underworld Dagger Surgeon's Catling Midnight Dagger Straight Swords: Dragonkin Seeker Sword Carian Knight's Sword Rotten Crystal Sword Draconic Epitaph Greatswords: Banished Knight’s Greatsword Inseparable Sword Colossal Swords: Troll Knight's Sword Thrusting Swords: Rogier's Rapier Antspur Rapier Frozen Needle Curved Swords: Mantis Blade Flowing Curved Sword Axes: Axe of Epiphany Jawbone Axe Celebrant's Cleaver Sacrificial Axe Icerind Hatchet Ripple Blade Flails: Mohgwyn Censer Great Hammers: Rotten Battle Hammer Greathorn Hammer Colossal Weapons: Rotten Greataxe Prelate's Inferno Crozier Great Club Spears: Celebrant's Rib Rake Torchpole Crystal Spear Rotten Crystal Spear Halberds: Vulgar Militia Shotel Vulgar Militia Saw Gargoyle's Halberd Gargoyle's Black Halberd Pest's Glaive Ripple Crescent Halberd Golden Halberd Loretta's War Sickle Scythes: Halo Scythe Whips: Hoslow's Petal Whip Fists: Clinging Bone Claws: Bloodhound Claws Torches: Sentry's Torch Shields: Ice Crest Shield Smoldering Shield Crest of the Dragon Cult Banished Knight Shield Silver Mirrorshield Icon Shield Crucible Hornshield Dragonclaw Shield Ant's Skull Plate The Forked Tongue Hatchet Ash of War (Dragonform Flame) has been reworked. Will be released in a future patch. Will temporarily be given Quickstep until the new Ash of War is released. Talismans The Verdigris Talisman will now prevent the player from being grabbed by Grab and Critical Attacks while on Heavy Weight or Overweight. The Verdigris Talisman will now also buff the player when on Medium (5%) or Light Load (2.5%) The Thief’s Bauble will now also prevent long landing animations, allowing you to continue walking/running right after landing. The Quiver Talisman now applies a penalty to the player while equipped, causing all ranged weapon attacks to consume 15% more stamina. Spells Using a Spell Catalyst that you do not have the requirements for will now prevent you from casting. Soul Steal is no longer blocked by Shields. Decreased the stagger values of Knight’s Lightning Spear. Updated the icon for Mark of Frenzy. Bug Fixes General Fixed an issue causing the feature that maintains nighttime after death to not work. Added various fixes causing Convergence and Seamless to fight over control of various aspects of the game. This can affect the following things: - Legendary and Perpetual Spells - Kill Boxes - Way-Gate Teleportation - Spirit Summoning - Death Ward - Passive FP Regen - Armor Abilities - Removing Spell Buffs when Armor Abilities are Triggered - Golden Extract - Midra’s Gaze through Transmog Music Fixed an issue where Goras, Scourge of Dreams did not have any music. Maps Removed a sudden loss of colors from certain enemies in Gaol Cave. Fixed an issue causing the fog wall in Lake of Rot for the Dragonkin to malfunction when in conjunction with Seamless Coop. Fixed an issue where the exit to the cave beneath the Cathedral of Manus Celes in Moonlight Altar was blocked. A new barrier has been placed that will vanish once the player has obtained the Dark Moon Ring via Ranni’s questline. Fixed an issue causing the player to teleport into the floor in certain situations after burning the Sealing Tree. Fixed an issue causing the player to spawn in the floor when warping to the Gravesite Woodland Site of Grace. Fixed an issue with an inappropriate text prompt near the entrance to Sellia Crystal Tunnel. Fixed an issue where the interaction prompt for the seal preventing the player from entering the Frenzy Flame Proscription was still active while the seal was gone. Fixed an issue in Dragonbarrow Cave where the interaction prompt for entering the fog wall was still active while the fog wall was removed upon revisit. Fixed an issue with a chest having the wrong interaction prompt near the entrance of Sellia Crystal Tunnel. Fixed an issue where players could not fast travel while inside Sealed Tunnel before the Onyx Lord boss was defeated. Fixed an issue where a mounted Kaiden Sellsword in Limgrave could get stuck running into a carriage. Fixed an issue where an incorrect interact prompt could still be seen on an open door near the Prison Town Church in Volcano Manor. Fixed an issue where an enemy would fall off the map in Castle Morne Adjusted the arena of the Monstrous Spider Scorpion boss at the Gravesite Woodlands Erdtree Waygate in order to prevent the boss from getting stuck or falling off the southern cliffside. Fixed a clipping issue in Giant’s Mountaintop Catacombs. Fixed various Asset Rendering issues in Nokron. Fixed various Asset Rendering issues in Upper Siofra.. Fixed a clipping issue in Caelid (Overworld). Fixed a Loot Corpse clipping issue in Highroad Cave. Fixed various asset issues in Caria Manor. Fixed an upside down asset in the Cave of the Forlorn. Fixed a visual glitch in Shaded Castle. Removed some floating pillars in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Made the backside of Fortified Manor in Leyndell, Royal Capital have an improved wall. Moved a Smithing Stone pickup so that it would not be inside a statue in Limgrave Tunnels. Fixed several asset clipping issues within Fringefolk Hero’s Grave. Fixed a minor issue with some floating assets near Siluria’s arena in Deeproot Depths. Fixed an issue where Roundtable Hold would unload while standing in a specific spot in the room where D dies. Fixed an issue where a phantom wolf was clipping inside of a rock near the Consecrated Snowfield Minor Erdtree. Fixed an issue where a shrub was floating near the Church of Pilgrimage. Fixed an issue where there was an enemy stuck in a wall in Stillwater Cave. Fixed an issue where the player could get flanked by an Erdtree Guardian while fighting the Erdtree Sentry boss at Minor Erdtree Church after warping there from another Erdtree Waygate. Moved a Blessing of Marika pickup in Shaman Village from inside a tree for visibility and access. Fixed a gap between the railing and pillars on the north side of the Limgrave to Liurnia Highway Bridge. Fixed many varied issues involving collision, one-sided assets, incorrect NPC behavior, and asset gaps in Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel. Fixed an issue where the “Rest of the Dread Dragon” grace would still be unlocked after reviving Bayle the Dread from Roundtable Hold. Fixed an issue where the chest containing Freyja’s Gauntlets at Fort Gael would close after opening it and reloading the area. Fixed a floating asset near the south corner of Redmane Castle. Fixed an issue where the player could warp directly to Enir Ilim by dying without touching a site of grace after burning the Sealing Tree. Fixed an issue where players could quit out during the Deeproot Depth boss encounters with “Crucible Knight Siluria”, “Aled, Knight of Godwyn”, and the “Blighted Nox Ancestor” without being warped out of the arenas when loading back in. Menu Fixed several grammatical errors and typos. Fixed an issue where certain items such as Bombs and Grease had no whitespace between the name and the X, for example ‘Rot Grease x3’ Dry Leaf Dane is now marked as Defeated instead of Dead when defeated near Moorth Ruins. Fixed an issue where the Recent Items loading screen tooltip and Recent Items inventory icons were not showing. Enemies Corrected the activation range of the Erdtree Sentry in the Minor Erdtree Church. Corrected the activation range of the Dyru, Scavenger King in the Castle Morne. Fixed an issue causing the Sanguine Noble NPC to not dual-wield the Bloodflame Kama’s Fixed an issue where Nerijus was using the Bloodflame Kama’s. Fixed an issue where the Putrid Knight would lose his horse during a specific attack. Fixed an issue where the minibosses in Deeproot Depths would not activate your Great Rune after being defeated. Fixed an issue where Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame would not activate your Great Rune after being defeated. Fixed an issue where boss music would play when approaching the Erdtree Sentries in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Fixed an issue where Dyru, Scavenger King’s Holy Attacks would apply Blackflame visuals to the player. Fixed an issue where a Silver Tear Orb in Fringefolk Hero’s Grave would not drop any Runes on death. Fixed an issue where in Sellia Crystal Tunnel a Starcaller would still teleport regardless if it was dead or not. Fixed an issue where some of Caimar, Spiritshaper’s attacks would not have any visuals in certain situations. Fixed an issue where Adula would roar when coming up the elevator in Caria Manor, regardless if she was dead or had moved to the Moonlight Plateau. Potentially fixed an issue where Godskin Matriarch would repeat her phase transition animation immediately after phase transitioning. Potentially fixed an issue where Spiritshaper Caimar would queue up an inappropriate attack during his phase transition that did not account for where the player would be after the phase transition animation ended. Fixed an issue where enemies at Guardians’ Garrison in Mountaintops of the Giants would attempt to climb a ladder that had been removed. Fixed an issue where the Vessel of Rot wouldn’t phase transition after being defeated while in the middle of a jumping animation. Armor Fixed an issue where the Ragged Loincloth’s ability would not trigger when shooting an arrow but instead when hitting an arrow. Fixed an issue where the Upper Class Robe gave an incorrect buff icon. Fixed an issue where the Traveling Perfumer’s Robe gave an incorrect buff icon. Items Updated several references of range increase to use a percentage instead of a flat value to accurately reflect the bonus provided. Updated the description of Rellana’s Cameo to note the updated bonus damage effect provided from “15%” to “45%”. Updated the Elden Lord Armor (Altered) description to reflect the changes to the active effect made in a prior patch. The Tarnished can now build up stacks of a new resource called Current. Certain spells build Current whilst other spells release Current. Spells that release Current will be stronger if you have the required amount of Current when you are casting the spell. If you do not have the required amount of Current, the spell will be cast in a weaker form. Spells that consume all Current will scale based on how many Current has been consumed. Carwyn’s Epee has been moved to a chest in Castle Morne. Maps Stormveil Castle and Raya Lucaria’s layouts and progression have been overhauled. Castle Morne has been expanded and the layout has been overhauled. It has been made into a more traditional Legacy Dungeon. Expanded the Mystic theme of the Volcano Cave out into the area leading up to it. Overhauled the walkway up to Stormveil, before Margit. Replaced the portal at the end Morne Tunnel with a two-way door that brings you to Castle Morne. Restored the portal that brings you from the Slumbering Wolf’s Shack to Consecrated Snowfields. Enemies in lava (such as the enemies in Volcano Manor) will no longer be immune to fire damage, but will not take damage from the lava itself. Doubled the tick rate of lava damage. Fixed an issue that would cause unexpected behavior when using the Erdtree Teleporters while running Convergence and Seamless Coop together. Added Spirit Springs to the following locations: - Near the entrance to the Black Knife Catacombs, leading up to the Frenzied Flame Village. - Near a wall going up from the Bellum Highway to the Mausoleum Compound. - Near a wall behind Castle Sol, allowing you to jump down from the cliff overlooking the castle. - Behind Gowry’s Shack, going up to the platform with the Church of the Plague. Restored the summoning signs of Shabriri and Nepheli Loux in the Ashen Capital before Godfrey. Restored the summoning sign of Great Horned Tragoth on the Altus Plateau before the Draconic Tree Sentinel. Fixed an issue where Millicent would return to her world when summoning her to fight the Draconic Tree Sentinel. Restored the summoning sign of Recusant Bernahl in Farum Azule before Seera, Blade of the Ancients. Restored the summoning sign of Dung Eater in the Royal Capital before Morgott. Fixed an issue where Crucible Knight Siluria’s fog wall would not appear in certain situations. Corrected the location of the Beside the Crater-Pocked Glade grace on the map. Fixed an issue where the Siofra River Bank grace would not appear in certain situations. Fixed an issue where the walls would become invisible near the Siofra River Bank grace. Placed Gostoc back into Godrick’s boss room. Fixed an issue where the portal in Fortissax’s arena could only be used if you had at least two great runes. Corrected an issue where the Spell Cost reduction from Astral Alignment would not work properly. Corrected the height of a ghost tree in North Mountaintops of the Giants. Added invisible walls to the railing of Morgott and Godfrey’s boss arena to prevent parkouring in. Corrected locations in Deeproot Depths where torrent was supposed to be disabled. Corrected the descriptions of several Dragon Communion spells. Increased the damage over time of the Suffocate spell. Added damage over time to the Air Tax spell. Fixed an issue causing Renna’s Barrier and Armor of Rime to cancel each other. Fixed an issue causing Crimson Rose to have inconsistent hitboxes. Increased the range of Blood Comet. Corrected the description of Roiling Magma to be more accurate. Fixed an issue causing Blessing of Wisdom to also boost holy weapon damage. (If you wish to load and use your previous save files that are stored in the vanilla location, simply remove the eldenring_alt_saves.dll file from the ConvergenceER folder before launching the mod. Version 1.0 - Alpha Release Game System Changes: Fast travel can now be performed while in combat. Fast travel can now be performed while in dungeons. Map cursor speed has been increased. Crafting materials will be auto-looted when you get near them. All characters have inherent FP regeneration of 1 FP per second. Vigor scaling has been adjusted to give more HP in the early game. Defeating any boss will activate the Rune Arc effect. A boss refight system is available on the ground floor of Roundtable Hold that will allow the player to fight any remembrance boss that they have previously defeated. The status effects of the game have been changed: A. Scarlet Rot - Deals less damage over its duration. Poison - Deals more damage over its duration. Deathblight - Now affects all enemies - Lowers the target’s resistance to status effects by 50% and lowers the target’s absorption by 20% for 20 seconds. D. Madness - Now affects all enemies - Deals 6% of total HP as damage on target upon proc and the target deals 20% less damage for 20 seconds afterwards. E. Frostbite - Initial HP loss on proc has been lowered to 6% from 10%. F. Bleed - HP loss has been lowered to 9% from 15% per proc. G. Sleep - For 20 seconds after proc, reduces the damage the target deals and increases the damage the target receives. (Most enemies, even if they have no sleep animation will still receive sleep procs.) The great runes have been redesigned: Godrick’s Great Rune - Increases Total HP by 10% and increases runes gained by 10%. Radahn’s Great Rune - Increases total HP by 10% and increases Endurance by 5. Rykard’s Great Rune - Increases total HP by 20% Morgott’s Great Rune - Increases total HP by 10% and Mind by 5. Mohg’s Great Rune - Increases total HP by 10% and adds passive HP regeneration. Malenia’s Great Rune - Increases total HP by 10% and each melee hit you deal recovers HP. Progression Changes: You begin the game with the Spectral Steed Whistle. The first encounter with Melina has been removed. The Melina encounters in Leyndell have been removed except the one after defeating Morgott. All maps are revealed from the start of the game. The Crafting Kit, the Whetstone Knife and the Flask of Wondrous Physick are now found in the room that your character spawns in at the start of the game. All weapon affinities are unlocked at the start of the game. All talisman slots are unlocked at the start of the game. All characters start with 3 spell slots. Area scaling of the game has been adjusted in numerous ways to better support a more open-world model. Each flask reinforcement can be done with only one Golden Seed per flask use. All talismans and physick tears are now acquired through a new system found in the grace menu called “Remnant Crafting.” Physick tears are crafted using new items called Physick Remnants which are found on Erdtree Avatars and Erdtree Sentries. Talismans are crafted using other various remnants that are found throughout the world. Each minor Ertree and many other locations now have portals near them. These portals form a new travel system allowing for faster movement across the world. Each portal will activate when the Erdtree Sentry or Erdtree Avatar next to the portal is defeated. You may travel to any other portal from any portal but you cannot travel from a portal until the sentry or avatar is dead. Ashen Capital is now accessed after burning the Erdtree the first time either with Melina or with the frenzy quest. Defeating Maliketh no longer causes the player to teleport to Ashen Capital. Farum Azula is now accessed two ways. One entrance is via a portal behind the Beast Sanctum in Caelid. The other is via one of the portals at The Four Belfries. Weapon reinforcement has been redesigned: All weapons will now be reinforced to +10 at maximum and the amount of damage and scaling benefit between standard and somber reinforcement are identical. See the tables below for reinforcement details. All armor has had its weight reduced. All armor now has passive effects. Each effect can be seen in the armor’s description. Several new armor sets have been added for many of the new classes as starting armor. Spell Changes: Approximately 360 new spells have been added to the game. Spells are divided into 18 schools each with around 20-25 spells. The spell schools are as follows: Sorcery: Glint - (Magic Damage - INT Scaling) Gravity - (Physical Damage - INT Scaling) Dragonkin - (Lightning Damage - INT Scaling - Frostbite) Lava - (Fire Damage - INT/FTH Scaling) Night - (Magic Damage - INT/FTH Scaling) Death - (Holy Damage - INT/FTH Scaling - Frostbite/Deathblight) Storm - (Physical Damage - INT/FTH Scaling) Frost - (Magic Damage - INT/ARC Scaling - Frostbite) Aberrant - (Physical Damage - INT/ARC Scaling - Bleed) Incantations: Bestial - (Physical Damage - FTH Scaling) Golden Order - (Holy Damage - FTH Scaling) Giantsflame - (Fire Damage - FTH Scaling) Dragon Cult - (Lightning Damage - FTH Scaling) Godslayer - (Holy Damage - INT/FTH Scaling) Frenzy - (Fire Damage - INT/FTH Scaling - Madness) Bloodflame - (Fire Damage - FTH/ARC Scaling - Bleed) Servants of Rot - (Physical Damage - FTH/ARC Scaling - Poison/Rot/Deathblight/Bleed) Mystic - (Magic Damage - FTH/ARC Scaling - Sleep) Sorcery scrolls and incantation prayerbooks have been removed. Spells are now learned by using new consumables called spell runes. Each spell school has 5 spell runes in various locations in the world. When consumed, a spell rune will auto-loot several spells to your character. Crafting Changes: All cookbooks are unlocked at the start of the game. The requirement for Cracked Pots, Ritual Pots and Perfume Bottles has been removed. All craftable items can be crafted with the materials alone. All crafted consumables have been changed to make Arcane the primary stat they scale with. The item amount that is crafted of most consumables and ammunition has been increased each time you craft. Glintstone Scraps, Large Glintstone Scraps, Explosive Stones, Explosive Stone Clumps, Poison Stones, Poison Stone Clumps, Gravity Stone Chunks and Gravity Stone Fans are now craftable. Talisman and Physick Changes: Most talismans and Physick Tears have been changed in some way, either improved or rebalanced. Some talismans have been combined into one talisman that has the effects of two from base game in order to increase their power level. As a result some talismans have been removed entirely. All talismans and Physick Tears are now crafted with remnants in the remnant crafting menu found at graces. Combat, Enchanted and Heirloom Remnants are found throughout the world in various locations. Relic Remnants are only dropped by main progression bosses. Essence, Elemental, Prowess, Invigorating and Enduring Physick Remnants are dropped by Erdtree Avatars and Erdtree Sentries. Unique Skill: Darkness (30 FP) Raise the sword aloft and cleave surroundings with darkness. Deals magic damage and temporarily reduces magic damage negation. How to Obtain The Sword of Darkness has to be converted from the Stone-Sheathed Sword or the Sword of Light at a specific location depending on where the Stone-Sheathed Sword was picked up. If the Stone-Sheathed Sword has been picked up at either the Ruins of Unte or the Ancient Ruins of Rauh, the altar to convert it will be at: Gravesite Plains - Found in front of an altar in the deeper parts of the Fog Rift Catacombs. To access, descend into the catacombs, until you reach a room with three trapped ceilings. Make your way to the end of the room and jump unto the contraption and ride up. From this point you can walk across to reach the altar. If the Stone-Sheathed Sword has been picked up at the Fog Rift Catacombs, the altar to convert it will be at: Ruins of Unte - Found in front of an altar in the blocked courtyard of the Ruins of Unte. You need to wake up the Furnace Golem blocking the way to the church access the item. To do this, throw one of the large fire pots at it's face from a higher point. Ancient Ruins of Rauh - Found in front of an altar. To access this area travel Northwest from the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West site of grace and enter the temple. Travel through the scarlet rot area while keeping northwest. After exiting the ruins you can see the tower ahead which can be easily accessed by an invisible, straight bridge. The altar is on top of said tower. Notes For detailed weapon stats you can visit Elden Ring Weapon Calculator Copyright © 2026 Convergence Mod Design by ThemesDNA.com
